CREATE VIEW vw_observation_quality AS
SELECT 
    o.observstation,
    t.telescregistry AS telescope,
    s.signalregistry AS signal,
    s.snrratio,
    sp.falseposprob,
    sp.corrscore,
    sp.anomscore,
    sd.sigintegrity,
    sd.tempstab,
    sd.freqstab,
    sd.sigcoherence,
    sc.classconf,
    -- Computed observation quality score
    ROUND(
        (s.snrratio / NULLIF(MAX(s.snrratio) OVER(), 0)) * 100 
        + (1 - sp.falseposprob) * 100 
        + sp.corrscore * 100
        + sd.sigintegrity * 0.5
        + sc.classconf * 0.3
    , 2) AS observation_quality_score
FROM signals s
JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
LEFT JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON s.signalregistry = sp.signalref
LEFT JOIN signaldynamics sd ON s.signalregistry = sd.signalref
LEFT JOIN signalclassification sc ON s.signalregistry = sc.signalref;
